mainEntity.name: How do I create a realistic budget for my remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: To create a realistic remodel budget, begin by identifying your priorities and must-have features. Research average costs for similar projects in the Berkeley and East Bay areas. Include a contingency fund, typically 10-20% of your total budget, for unexpected expenses. Discuss your budget openly with your contractor, as they can provide valuable insights and help you make cost-effective decisions.
